_doc: Named traditions. A tradition is cited by name and is never promoted to Text.

traditions.name: Ramayana katha performance tradition
traditions.note: Oral performance. Named, dated where possible, never folded into the spine.

traditions.name: Sanskrit commentarial tradition on the Valmiki Ramayana
traditions.note: Tilaka, Bhusana and others. Cited individually, never as 'tradition says'.
